In detail

Piazza Santo Spirito is a well-known student/nightlife square in the Oltrarno with bars and evening gatherings, and has drawn periodic 'movida sicura' police checks alongside neighbouring San Niccolò. However, the specific district-by-district crime breakdown covering the Quartiere 1 historic centre explicitly noted zero serious incidents here recently, attributed to improved community-police coordination, in contrast to nearby San Frediano and the station area. Sources checked: La Firenze che Vorrei, quartiere-by-quartiere summer crime report (Quartiere 1 data); 055firenze.it / MET Provincia di Firenze, 'movida sicura' checks in Oltrarno and San Niccolò.
